## Instructions for Accurately Reporting Failed Municipal Water-Quality Tests to Protect the Public

The discovery of failed water-quality tests in a municipal water system is a serious event demanding swift, accurate, and transparent communication. Failing to report or downplaying the issue can have severe consequences for public health, erode public trust, and expose the municipality to legal liability. These instructions provide a comprehensive framework for appropriately reporting and managing failed water-quality tests.
